N891-quantum-evaluator-information-and-control-design | Quantum evaluator information and control-design certificates
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Specified Willow d5 X-basis circuit and declared allowed linear features; arbitrary binary records for algebraic span claims; acquired aggregate spin-code data and isolated control-channel models separately scoped.

Exact statement: Detectors plus full initial ancilla frame span exactly all ancilla outcomes plus terminal stabilizer parities. A weight-five target-flipping translation proves no deterministic target reconstruction from those features on arbitrary records; exhaustive terminal coset enumeration identifies the minimum raw-bit leakage addition. Four unexecuted new preparation patterns separate the inspected weight-two aliases; unrestricted linear/affine identification requires 19/20 further patterns. Isolated-channel uniform-floor control is beaten by a targeted ideal output twirl. None establishes a new decoder, causal hardware effect, CP process reconstruction or matched full-resource memory advantage.

Information, costs and evidence: Exact source assumptions only. Joint acquisition, complete support, conditioning, preparation/control/reset, precision and matched comparator costs are charged in the cited proofs. Internal mathematics, finite diagnostics, supplied empirical records and newly acquired primary evidence remain separate.

Failure / missing operation: Predeclare a richer randomized/interleaved preparation design and an allowed-feature receiver; obtain matching strongest X-basis predictions/checkpoints, paid control errors and shot-level complex process/uncertainty data. Keep reserved outcomes untrained and do not identify finite-support aliases causally.
